Processes.Snapshot: erl_ptab.c746+: consistent snapshot at a point during BIF; slots scanned under table lock; no EXITING filter; started_interval excludes later births; deleted-element log restores pre-invocation identifiers deleted before inspected chunk.
Processes.DeathBoundary: erl_process.c14454 deletes PTab entry in EXIT_FREE, after timers/ETS/system tasks and registered-name removal. Physical dirty native execution may outlive this point:14755+ sets F_DELAYED_DEL_PROC if DIRTY_RUNNING and postpones delete_process.
Processes.RejectedInference: Dirty callback still physically running does not imply PID must remain in processes/0. Adding every exitContinuation until physical retirement would be incorrect.
Processes.Managed: ProcessRuntime.cs794 ProcessSnapshot returns processes.Keys under runtime gate; Terminate removes processes/processSlots before asynchronous etsFoundation.ProcessTerminated and all other retirement tasks.
Processes.PotentialGap: An exiting managed process still in pre-FREE resource cleanup may be omitted too early. Source-guided hypothesis; no original runtime comparison or managed reproduction performed in this audit.
Processes.SnapshotConsistency: Single managed runtime-gate snapshot is consistent at one instant; different time slicing is not by itself a semantic bug.

Registered.Entry: register.c576 registered_0 holds global registry read lock and traverses process_reg hash into list.
Registered.Membership: RegProc entries contain process OR port; shared managed names dictionary already contains both.
Registered.ProcessDeath: erl_process.c14420-14426 unregisters name late in FREE before PTab removal and before monitors/links.
Registered.PortDeath: io.c3904-3905 unregisters port name immediately after entering EXITING, before link/monitor dispatch and physical driver/resource deletion.
Registered.Ordering: Source uses hash_foreach + list prepend; managed uses Dictionary insertion order. Public erlang.erl5912 docs promises registered names but no sorted or insertion order. Treat ordering as unresolved source/protocol scope until deliberately accepted; do not claim byte-identical whole list from sorted/projected comparisons.
Registered.PotentialGap: Managed FinishTermination delays all process-name removal through aggregated physical dirty retirement, while OTP can unregister before physical dirty body finishes. Requires actual controlled NIF/owned-resource comparison to confirm. Registered port-name timing also requires comparison against native frontend retirement.
